scope: Meal editor and transient ingredient review only. Recipe editor remains the current cloud implementation.

transforms: Copy shared composite stage, ingredient-row, dialog and footer styles before the recipe-serving picker section.
Keep cloud host adaptations and review/narrow footer rules in composite-editor.css.

reuse: Use existing MobileIngredientDetail and FoodNutritionView for canonical quantities, nutrition/unknown coverage and explicit draft Apply.
Use existing mountFoodPicker for paged catalog/library/recipe search; no meal recursion.
Use authenticated library preview and existing meal.save workspace transaction/receipt. Catalog snapshots are captured by the server on save.
Source stage order: Meal Name and Meal Items, then nutrition review; Next, Back, Save Meal and Save & Add. Save & Add opens the existing diary entry detail without logging.
Shared quantity-options projection supplies existing ingredient source/portion labels without per-item requests. Missing measurement bases stay unavailable.

verification.browser: Headless Chrome, 412 x 915, production HTTP CSP; actual library/controller/quantity/preview/store receipt composition.
coverage: Create/edit/cancel, child quantity cancellation, source labels, reorder, name retention across stages.
Food grams, recipe servings and public catalog grams; unknown nutrients and catalog provenance captured only on Save.
Preview failure and retry; no premature writes; immutable command replay after the committed reply is lost.
Save & Add opens mountFoodEntry with no diary entries; existing text review metadata preserved on rename.
Namespace-colliding food/recipe IDs and unknown measurement bases in the ingredient projection.
Existing Custom Food editor and Foods collection navigation remain functional.

limitations: The saved source used-item update/preserve review is not exposed by current cloud meal.save. This UI keeps existing edit semantics: dependent records without an occurrence override read the current saved meal definition. Restore reviewed update/preserve behavior with the later recipe/backend increment.
Catalog source facts are resolved by the canonical server at preview and save; this slice does not freeze or fingerprint them across those requests.
Recipe servings/cooked-weight/notes stages remain outside this Meal-only slice.
Ingredient search returns to a fresh search after closing a new ingredient detail; no barcode capture action is added here.
Headless browser verification is not a new physical-device comparison; hosted verification is owned by the release task.
